input.answer: Okay, so the page "מה האתר עוד לא מכסה" lists stuff it can't calculate yet: ETC, LBMA gold price, corporate bonds (אג"ח קונצרנית), Israel bonds (אגרת בונדס), a digital forex wallet, profit-sharing life insurance, ביטוח מנהלים, gold funds, structured products, managed currency funds, managed accounts and more, all marked "לא מחושב". Honestly though, it says those are "מוצרים" and then puts a debt arrangement, a rating company, a gold price and an exchange fee in there, none of which are things you can buy. So I'm only half trusting the list. At least it doesn't seem to mention plain index funds, which is the thing I care about.

stuck.why: The subtitle promises 'מוצרים שהאתר מכיר אבל עוד לא יכול להסביר עד הסוף', but then there are cards for 'הסדר חוב', 'חברת דירוג', 'LBMA Gold Price AM / PM' and 'עמלת חליפין'. Those are a process, a company, a price and a fee, not products. So I couldn't tell which cards are real options I could actually use
